scope: P1-A61 classic Liao Hua, Dangxian/Fuli rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网与BWIKI经典版本廖化（蜀4体力，当先／伏枥）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典廖化规则：当先在回合开始时强制执行一个额外出牌阶段；伏枥在自己濒死时可将体力回复至现存势力数并翻面。该页同时提供574x761经典静态大图。
交叉核对一将成名2012经典版本、蜀势力、4体力及当先／伏枥，并与界限突破版分栏，防止混入失去体力、获得杀或补手牌等增量。
按用户指定概念页拆分标签与执行形态：当先是无需确认且持续由规则自动执行的Locked + State；伏枥是本局限一次且在濒死时由玩家确认的Limited + Trigger。

ruleText.dangxian: 锁定技，回合开始时，你执行一个额外的出牌阶段。
ruleText.fuli: 限定技，当你处于濒死状态时，你可以将体力回复至X点（X为现存势力数），然后将你的武将牌翻面。

implementation.dangxianInteraction: a mandatory extra Play phase starts before the normal preparation and draw chain; phase-scoped Slash, active-skill, Wooden Ox and failed Jijiang state reset independently while turn-scoped Alcohol state remains
implementation.fuliInteraction: the existing private RescueDying prompt offers Fuli only to its dying owner; resolution consumes one game-scoped activation, recovers to the living-faction count capped by max HP, toggles face state and resumes the shared dying chain

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the mandatory extra phase, every accepted action, optional Fuli response, game-scoped usage, recovery and face state reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v109 keeps Dangxian and Fuli disabled even when package 1.88.0 is loaded; package 1.87.0 does not register Liao Hua

portrait.attribution: Official classic Liao Hua artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Dangxian starts before the normal draw phase and a paused extra Play phase restores exactly
ending Dangxian resumes the normal turn chain and creates a second Play phase with fresh phase-scoped Slash and skill limits
Fuli is offered only to its dying owner and freezes the current living-faction count in the private choice
Fuli recovers to four in the four-faction fixture, flips the general, consumes its game-scoped use and is never offered a second time
rules v109 and package 1.87.0 preserve both pre-Liao-Hua boundaries
official portrait, exact classic text, Locked/State and Limited/Trigger types, consumed limited status, private dying choice and public battle cues render without clipping or binding errors

excludedVariants: boundary-breakthrough Dangxian that may lose HP to gain a Slash and its additional effects
boundary-breakthrough Fuli hand-refill and other changed recovery behavior
mobile, national-war and other-product Liao Hua definitions
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
